CommunityResponse.title: CommunityResponse
CommunityResponse.description: A response submitted by a student, teacher, or community member sharing soil awareness pledges and observations.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the respondent

roleDetail.description: Optional specific role when Other is chosen (e.g., Farmer, Parent, Volunteer)

organization.description: Optional school, college, or community organization

pledge.description: Soil conservation pledge chosen by the respondent

soilAwarenessRating.description: 1 to 5 self-assessed awareness or local soil condition score

advice.description: Soil conservation advice or suggestion shared in the advice box

problemsFaced.description: Local soil pollution or land degradation problems faced by the respondent

whatCanBeDone.description: Practical actions or solutions suggested to resolve the problem faced

problemImage.description: Compressed base64 JPEG/PNG/WebP thumbnail showing the problem faced or target area

ecoActionImage.description: Compressed base64 JPEG/PNG/WebP thumbnail of the eco action taken

ResponseSummary.title: ResponseSummary
ResponseSummary.description: Public aggregate counts of responses by respondent category (zero PII).

otherCount.description: Responses from others (farmers, parents, community members)

lastResponseId.description: Document ID of the response created atomically with this summary update

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the summary update

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized tracker coordinator or teacher admin record.

/responses/{responseId}.description: Individual soil awareness responses from students, teachers, and others.

/stats/summary.description: Aggregate role breakdown counts updated atomically with each new response.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Registry of additional teacher/coordinator admins granted full response tracking access.
